extracted.name: More winterveg. Creamy veg in a white wine sauce
extracted.description: When you are single and you buy fresh veg in winter you always have to much.
instruction_lines: Put in the other veg and ad the wine.
Add the spices and the salt
Cover and let cook for 25 m check if you have no fluid left ad some water if necessary
If veg are tender ad cream and let it cook so you get a creamy sauce
Ad corsley chopped coriander leaves. Put out the hob.
Serve with giant couscous and a vegan spicy sausage
